name: shopfloor-sentinel
description: Traffic-light cyber health dashboard for SME factories

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix e2e install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm run test:gateway
scripts.test:gateway: cd gateway && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm --prefix e2e test
